utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — that would be a huge help. If you can jot down the repair needs and ask a few neighbors what’s most urgent, I’ll get everything organized for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll make a quick list of repair needs and ask a few neighbors what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Bo — thank you. I’ll have everything ready for Sunday at the community center, and your list will help us a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can bring patch mix and filler for the repair drive, and I’m happy to help coordinate drop-offs too. Just let me know what else you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Mara. I can help spread the word a little, if that would help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help, Rey—thank you. I’ll keep coordinating the drop-offs, and I’ll let you know if anything else is still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — Sunday at the community center works. If anyone has patch mix or filler, please bring it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a good turnout. I’ll keep an ear out for any patch mix or filler while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Ira. If you hear of any drop-off help too, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time are you thinking for the repair drive? And where should folks drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking we can do a Saturday afternoon drop-off, maybe at the community center. If you want, I can help spread the word to both groups.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday afternoon sounds fine—what time exactly, and should people bring things to the community center entrance?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, do we have the exact drop-off spot yet? Once you have it, I can plan around the school schedule too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I don’t have the exact drop-off spot yet—do you know it? Once we confirm that, I can line it up with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet—I was hoping you had it. Can you confirm it with me once you do?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m still planning to swing by and help out for a bit, and I’ll tell the others too. Let’s confirm the exact drop-off spot first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — once we’ve got the drop-off spot confirmed, I’m good to go.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll check on the exact drop-off spot and let you know as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what kind of repair help do you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive today. I’ll try to swing by later if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, Noah — if you make it, just bring whatever repair supplies you can. I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I haven’t checked yet, sorry—I’m a bit forgetful, but I can ask around and see what they still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries—I usually show up a bit late anyway, so just let me know when you find out what they still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Dane—I’ll ask around and let you know what they still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word to a few more neighbors right away. The more hands, the better for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll pass it along and see you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes, can you remind me what still needs fixing and when the repair drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s mostly the broken gate, the loose railing, and a few leaking faucets—could you check those? The repair drive is this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits from the neighbors, so I’m not totally sure. Do you know what they still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure on the full list yet, but I do know the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. I can ask around and check what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — Sunday at the community center helps a lot. If you hear what they still need, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Cleo, I can still drop off the screwdrivers, hammer, duct tape, and a few sturdy boxes for the repair drive. Let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That covers a lot, Gus — thanks. I’ll check our list and let you know if we’re still short on anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know if anything else is missing and I’ll swing by again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, thanks — is it inside the community center or at the main entrance? I just want to make sure I drop things off in the correct spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s at the main entrance of the community center, Pia — just drop everything there and I’ll help point you the right way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’ll bring it to the main entrance on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes, can you remind me what items are still needed and when the repair drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need patch mix and filler, and the repair drive is Sunday at the community center. I can also help keep track of who’s dropping things off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I can help, and I’ll keep an eye out for patch mix and filler.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m already telling folks about the repair drive, and I’ll keep spreading the word around the neighborhood right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s great — I’m happy to help too if you need another set of ears around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — I’d love that. I’ll keep spreading the word, and if you hear anyone who wants to pitch in, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m pretty flexible, but I can swing by mid-morning if that works. Just let me know what tools you still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mid-morning works for me—let’s say around 10:00. I’ll let you know what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I’ll bring the tape and screws by, and I’ll keep an ear out if anyone mentions other supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Nell — thank you. I’ll let you know the time as soon as it’s set, and I’ll keep gathering a few more small tools in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’m just going off what I’ve heard around the block, so I’ll listen for any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on tape, screws, and a couple of good-size tarps. If you can swing by, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring some tape and a tarp, and I’ll swing by a bit late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be a big help, thanks, Dane. We’ll still need screws, but I’ll keep an eye on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess—please do let me know. I’m trying to work it around school pickup, so the timing really matters.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll keep an eye out and pass along anything I hear. Hope you can make it around pickup time—it’s nice when everyone can chip in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess—I really appreciate it. If you hear the time, let me know and I’ll see what I can do around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Sunday at the community center works — I’ll come by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive today. I’ll try to swing by later if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — just drop by if you can, and please knock softly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t checked the repair drive spots yet, but I can take a look and note what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that works—can you check them and let me know what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sounds like it’s getting a few more donations than expected. I’m a bit forgetful, but I can help keep an eye out for anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. If you hear they still need filler or patch mix, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear they need filler or patch mix.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can bring some patch mix and filler for the repair drive, and I can help coordinate who’s dropping things off if that would help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That would help a lot—thanks, Mara. I’ll let you know if I hear they still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — just keep me posted, and I’ll help round up the drop-offs if needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—post the repair drive details on the community hall bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what time is the repair drive happening, and where should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure on the time yet, but the drop-off is at the community center. I can check on the time and get back to you.
